players.product: Semiconductor specialty gases: nitrogen trifluoride (NF3), tungsten hexafluoride (WF6), hexafluoro-1,3-butadiene and carbonyl sulfide; KSG-5 low-GWP etching gas

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Six months ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 30,841 million (-1.4%), mainly on lower Fine Chemicals and Iron-based sales; operating profit JPY 815 million (JPY 1,721 million a year earlier); ordinary profit JPY 972 million (-59.7%) as battery-material technical support fees and foreign-exchange gains fell and R&D and personnel costs rose; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 106 million (-92.6%) after a loss from the disaster. R&D spending in the half was JPY 1,169 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 30,841 million (-1.4%); ordinary profit JPY 972 million (-59.7%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 106 million (-92.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Fine Chemicals, six months ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): sales JPY 24,434 million (-1.7%), operating profit JPY 658 million (-63.9%). Semiconductor specialty gases: carbonyl sulfide and nitrogen trifluoride (whose output was cut by the fire) fell on lower volume; KSG-14 and hexafluoro-1,3-butadiene rose on higher volume and tungsten hexafluoride on price revisions. Lithium hexafluorophosphate fell on lower volume and prices, and no licence technical support fees arose. Operating profit fell on the lost technical support fees, higher raw-material prices for semiconductor specialty gases and higher depreciation as Phase II construction at the Chinese subsidiary in Xuancheng started operation.
quarterly_data.figure: Fine Chemicals sales JPY 24,434 million (-1.7%); operating profit JPY 658 million (-63.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Shibukawa Plant fire (semi-annual report): a fire broke out at the Shibukawa Plant (Shibukawa, Gunma) on August 7, 2025, killing one employee and injuring one; nitrogen trifluoride production was reduced by the fire. The company set up an accident investigation committee and published the cause, recurrence-prevention measures and each product's operating status on November 10, 2025 in its sixth notice on the fire.
